snippet.title: Agricola - The King's Farmer Trailer
snippet.description:
Agricola – The King's Farmer is available on Steam and Google Play!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4618250/Agricola__The_Kings_Farmer/
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kannzaubern.AgricolaTheKingsFarmer

Available in: English, German, Polish, Turkish, Indonesian, French, Italian, Spanish, Dutch, Portuguese (Brazil), Hungarian, Czech.

Agricola – The King's Farmer is a classic, challenging economic simulation. Build your farm from the ground up — cultivate your fields, raise cows, train horses, and harvest your forest. Your goal: Become the new ruler of your land. Will you succeed?
